description: Score and improve AI agent responses across six dimensions (intent, reasoning, tools, safety, efficiency, value). Use when an agent's answer was wrong, the user said 'that's not right' or 'actually no', output quality dropped, or you're tuning an agent before deployment.
useCase: Score AI agent turns across six dimensions when something was wrong, quality dropped, or you need a baseline before deployment. Designed for moment-of-need triggers (user corrections, regressions, A/B testing).

risks.mitigation: Inspect per-dimension scores, not just average

risks.risk: Raw traces may contain user data

output.format: Markdown guidance with inline JSON evaluation examples
